$provenance.sourceWorkbook: Ultimate Annual Budget ("Workbook"), the owner's copy, Google Sheets export (not committed)

cells.funds: Savings!B5, B7 (card 1), F5, F7 (card 2); F14 =SUM(B7), J14 =SUM(B5), F15 =SUM(F7), J15 =SUM(F5)
cells.dates: Savings!N14, R14; N15 and R15 are blank

$provenance.note: Workbook's sample data, not the owner's. Read with openpyxl data_only=True (cached values). Plan S16, workbook-savings: the first two fund cards and their rows of "How To Reach These Goals".

$semantics.amountNeeded: B9 =SUM(B7-B5) and F9 =SUM(F7-F5): the goal less the current amount, with no floor (F21).
$semantics.monthsRemaining: V14 =IF(OR(ISBLANK(N14),ISBLANK(R14)),"",DATEDIF(N14,R14,"M")): whole months from the typed start date to the goal date, not from today, so it is date-independent (F21).
$semantics.monthlyContribution: Z14 =IFERROR((F14-J14)/V14, 0) caches 88.9047619, i.e. 186700 / 21 = 8890.476… cents. F9 rounds up to the cent: 8891.
$semantics.currentAmount: J14 and J15 read the typed Current Amount (B5, F5). In the app the current amount is the fund's balance (D16); here it is given directly, as typed, with no transfers.
$semantics.departures: Z15: Travel Fund has no dates, so V15 is "" and IFERROR shows 0. The app returns no contribution and says no dates yet (D15). The cached 0 is kept only to show the departure; it is never asserted as expected.
$semantics.merchants: The engine takes no merchant text. Fund names come from START HERE!H7:H8 via Savings!C4, G4.
